explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 filters the views where AUTHOR_ID = VIEWER_ID, while Q2 does not have this filter and instead joins the VIEWS table with itself on the condition that AUTHOR_ID = VIEWER_ID, which can lead to duplicate rows in the result set.
counterexample_dsp: The difference is triggered when there are multiple views by the same author that are also viewed by the same author, as Q2 will count each of these as a separate row due to the join, while Q1 will not.
